data.title: Coalition: Operational Capabilities Facilitating Weapons and Ballistic Missile Smuggling at Port of Hodeidah Targeted
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that operational capabilities at the port of Hodeidah, which facilitated the smuggling and transport of weapons and ballistic missiles, have been targeted.
    He further indicated that an ongoing operation is underway to destroy military targets and ballistic capabilities in the governorates of Sanaa, Saada, and Taiz.
    -- SPA
17:24 Local Time 14:24 GMT
0053
